description: This file defines an enumeration 'ChargePaymentMode' for representing different charge payment modes in the Fineract project. It includes two modes: REGULAR and ACCOUNT_TRANSFER, each associated with an integer value.

classes.name: ChargePaymentMode
classes.description: An enum representing different modes of charge payment with associated integer values.

methods.description: Constructor for the ChargePaymentMode enum that assigns an integer value to the mode.
